Name: Lumisteria More Flowery Grass
Author: Lumisteria
TagLine: This mod is a content pack for the "More Grass" mod. It adds a lot of flowery grass in spring, summer and fall.
Description:
This mod is a content pack for the "[More Grass](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398)" Mod.
It adds a lot of flowery grass in spring, summer, and fall.

![](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/562403895637442560/678709677315457024/unknown.png)
(The character hat is coming from "[Seasonal Hats](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2855)")

If you want a dense effect, i suggest you to rename "exampleconfig.json" currently included in the mod to "config.json".
